result.topic_en: Pencil notes, apparently on teaching or presenting a mathematical discipline (likely number theory). They cover its links to other disciplines, the difficulty of defining number, and multiplication defined as repeated addition.

methods.what: Definition of multiplication as repeated addition: a×b means a taken b times as a summand (a multiplicand, b multiplier)

items.quote:
Der Begriff der Zahl ist ein so verbreiteter,
dass er sich sehr schwer definiren lässt.
items.english: The concept of number is so widespread that it is very hard to define.

items.english: The theory has the advantage that it connects (directly?) to the first elements and yet leads very [quickly] to difficult results.

items.english: A history of the science in connection [is not possible?] as long as one does not know the science completely in its essential results.

items.english: The whole numbers are presupposed. On the other hand, start only with the generation of number by way of multiplication.
